title: Frozen Life
description: Custom Season addon for the Life Series mod by Mat0u5
body:
Custom Life Series Season for Mat0u5's Life Series Mod!
Works with any season except Limited Life

Don't let all your lives melt away!

## WHAT IS FROZEN LIFE?
- Third/Last Life, but your lives freeze when you die
- This means is your lives will take about 5 minutes to melt after you die before you actually lose the life.
- This gives players chances to take advantage of gimmicks such as being able to kill dark greens for lives, or giving a friend a life so they're not taken out of the game after dying on red.
- Lives you gain will also take time to melt until you are given them.
  - For now, this does not apply to the /givelife command.
- Lives only melt when the sun is out or when you are in a warm biome.
- Red Winter will begin when everyone is red, where it becomes too cold for lives to melt and deaths become instant.

## HOW DO I SET IT UP?
- Preferrably, enable the **Last Life** season. 
- If you don't like having randomized lives, set everyone to **5 lives** at the start.
- The map should be in a snow biome, but it doesn't have to be.
  
- A custom life giving command has been implemented to work using /trigger GiveLife. Disable the mod's givelife command using _/lifeseries config_.
- By default, players on red or yellow names can gain lives by killing dark greens. To disable this, say _/scoreboard players set !config greenkills 1_
- 

Enjoy!
